statement: N-0095 test-fixture rule: a customer is real when its code is TMP-CUST-*, CUST-* or OPEN_CHANNEL and its name is not a known fixture name (RelAmazon, Acme Retail <hex>, Merge Test ...); everything else (C-FULL, C-REL, C-SEAL, KEEP-, DG-, MAP-, TECHGRP-1/2, PLAN-BULK, ILIKE-CUST-UNQ) is test data, left out of the related-name and past-merges lists and the seal backfill, and never edited. Evidence: cip has 143 such rows, 28 of them in merges. Reversible: the rule is one function (customer_test_fixtures.is_test_fixture_customer).
